Brazilian Knots Extensions in NYC

Luxe Aura Hair Extensions Brazilian Knots Extensions is the process of applying strands of hair extensions onto your hair using a gentle stretchy thread. The thread makes it easier to maintain your hair and will withstand heat better than other strand by strand methods.

We have found the method to be perfect for anyone who likes rollersets, blowdries, and will require chemical processes in areas where the extensions are applied while they are installed.

Curly hair clients as well as natural hair clients love this method the most even though it is perfect for anyone!

Will Brazilian Knots Extensions Damage Your Hair?

Luxe Aura Hair Brazilian Knots Extensions is designed to be gentle on the hair by providing a more natural application process. Brazilian Knots Extensions do not require glue, beads, or stressful sewing to apply which therefore makes it healthy and safe on the hair.

How Long Do Brazilian Knots Extensions Last?

How Much Do Brazilian Knots Extensions Cost?

Luxe Aura Hair Brazilian Knots Extensions range from $650 USD plus for full head application. Our prices are specifically based on the amount of hair you will require for your application.

Are Brazilian Knots Extensions for Curly Hair?

The answer is absolutely! This method has been specifically designed for natural and curly hair clients who are looking for the flexibility to heat style their curly new growth without having the extensions fall off.

items.title: What are Brazilian Knots hair extensions, and how do they work?
items.html: DescripBrazilian Knots hair extensions are a strand-by-strand extension method that uses a small, stretchy thread to attach extension hair to natural hair without glue or beads. At Luxe Aura Hair in NYC, this method is an option for clients seeking added length and volume with flexibility for different styling routines. The right application depends on your natural hair condition, texture, and desired result.tion text goes here

items.title: Are Brazilian Knots extensions safe for natural or curly hair?
items.html: Brazilian Knots extensions can be suitable for natural and curly hair when the method is appropriate for the client's hair condition and applied correctly. The technique does not require glue or beads, but that does not guarantee damage-free results. Excessive tension, unsuitable extension weight, or improper maintenance can still cause breakage. A professional consultation can help determine whether this method is suitable for your hair.

items.title: Can you heat-style or chemically treat your hair with Brazilian Knots extensions?
items.html: Brazilian Knots extensions may offer flexibility for styling routines that include blowouts and roller sets. However, heat should be used carefully to protect both your natural hair and the extensions. Chemical treatments require extra consideration because they may affect the extension hair, attachment thread, or natural hair. Consult your stylist before applying chemicals or performing treatments while wearing extensions.

items.title: How long do Brazilian Knots hair extensions last?
items.html: The lifespan of Brazilian Knots extensions depends on your natural hair growth, the application technique, daily styling, and maintenance routine. Regular professional assessments can help determine when the extensions need adjustment or removal. Luxe Aura Hair can provide personalized maintenance guidance based on your hair texture, lifestyle, and extension installation.

items.title: How much do Brazilian Knots extensions cost in NYC?
items.html: Brazilian Knots extensions at Luxe Aura Hair start at $650 for a full-head application. The final price depends on the amount of extension hair required and your desired length and fullness. A personalized consultation can help determine how much hair you need and provide a more accurate estimate for your Brazilian Knots service.
